analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking to find out whether antennas used with the [product_name] are compatible with the [product_name], particularly during hardware upgrades. The main issue is unclear or outdated documentation, which leads to uncertainty about compatibility and encourages manual testing.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that antennas used with previous versions of [product_name] should be compatible with newer modules or, at the very least, that documentation will provide clear compatibility information. They also wish to avoid placing antennas inside metal cabinets and are searching for more current and accessible documentation.
